metadata.case_name: TSANG KEE CHUEN v. THE HONG KONG AND YAUMATI FERRY COMPANY LIMITED

plaintiff.occupation_before: skilled jewellery worker / maker of jewellery

injuries.description: Left eye - (1) Laceration to the left eye and face, resulting in the rupture of the left eye hall and complete and permanent loss of vision in the left eye; (2) ptosis of the upper left eyelid; (3) depression of the left eyeball.
injuries.body_part: left eye / left side of face
source: Left eye - (1) Laceration to the left eye and face,  resulting in the rupture of the left eye  hall and complete and permanent loss of  vision in the left eye;  (2) ptosis of the upper left eyelid;  (3) depression of the left eyeball.
injuries.icd_description: Ocular laceration or rupture with prolapse or loss of intraocular tissue, unilateral

injuries.description: Fractures - (1) a fracture of the zygomatic arch; (2) a fracture of the lateral wall of the maxillary antrum; (3) a fracture of the medial wall of the left orhit and hard palate.
injuries.body_part: zygomatic arch; lateral wall of the maxillary antrum; medial wall of the left orbit and hard palate
source: Fractures - (1) a fracture of the zygomatic arch;  (2) a fracture of the lateral wall of the  maxillary antrum;  (3) a fracture of the medial wall of the left  orhit and hard palate.
injuries.icd_description: Multiple fractures involving skull or facial bones

injuries.description: Scaring - to the right upper lip 1" in length going upwards and obliquely to end at the base of the left nostril.
source: Scaring - to the right upper lip 1" in length going  upwards and obliquely to end at the base of the  left nostril.
injuries.icd_description: Superficial injury of lip or oral cavity

injuries.description: Teeth - loss of right two central incisors.
source: Teeth - loss of right two central incisors.

manifestations.description: complete and permanent loss of vision in the left eye
ptosis of the upper left eyelid (eyelid has dropped)
depression (sunken) of the left eyeball (cheek bone in vicinity of eye socket appears depressed; eyeball sunken)
pain in his left eye and that it weeps from time to time
scarring to the right upper lip 1" in length going upwards and obliquely to end at the base of the left nostril (disfiguring)
loss of right two central incisors
impaired sense of smell (initially complete after the accident with some later improvement)
rendered unconscious immediately after being hit
on a liquid diet for 50 days
on sick leave for about 3 months

reduced social life; inability to play badminton, basketball, football; upset at feeling unable to join in picnics and swimming parties; 'I do not go on picnics because I am afraid that I might be a burden to others and might worsen the atmosphere.'

treatments_received: conservative further treatment to the left eye
treatments_future: further conservative treatment for the left eye (continuing)

losses.description: Very disfiguring injury to the left side of his face: cheek bone depressed, eyeball sunken, eyelid dropped; can only open eyelid manually; permanent disfigurement.
Complete and permanent loss of vision in the left eye.
Impaired sense of smell following the accident (initially complete with some later improvement).

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Inability to play badminton, basketball, football and to join in picnics and swimming parties.
Social life has suffered; subjectively minimal social life and dismayed at loss of activities; avoids picnics for fear of being a burden.

comparable_cases.injury_description: loss of an eye (younger man; eyeball alone; socket intact; prosthesis could be fitted)
loss of an eye (previous highest award mentioned)
